verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop and mobile SSH client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting to disable analytics, telemetry or usage tracking. Hiding the AI widget, local encrypted storage and automatic session-log collection are adjacent features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
